process_area.title: Plastic Footprint Auditing, ERP Packaging Modeling & Registration

value_stream.name: Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) Compliance & Plastic Recovery Network

fields.Participants: Merchandising Category Managers (VS-01), Master Data Team (VS-29), Procurement (VS-03), External Auditor
fields.Trigger: EPR program launch; annual compliance planning (VS-25)

workflows.name: Plastic Packaging Footprint Baseline Audit & Material Taxonomy Setup

Automation Opportunity: - System calculation matching SKU sales to packaging weight taxonomy profiles.
Controls: - CTL-767: Baseline footprint signed off by external environmental auditor; taxonomy mapping locked in master data.
Cross-references: - links to VS-25 (ESG), VS-29 (master data), VS-03 (procurement), VS-87 (customs)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Incomplete SKU data**: Stale packaging weight database leading to under-reporting; mitigated by mandatory supplier packaging disclosures during onboarding.
System Touchpoints: - ERP Item Master (VS-29), Sales ledger (VS-16), Imports database (VS-02.2/VS-87).

steps.a: Sustainability/ESG Manager / EPR Compliance Manager
steps.activity: Define plastic material categories per RA 11898 (rigid plastic, flexible single-layer, flexible multi-layer, polystyrene).
steps.r: Sustainability/ESG Manager / EPR Compliance Manager

steps.a: Sustainability/ESG Manager / EPR Compliance Manager
steps.activity: Audit packaging weight and type for all active SKUs (~35,000; item-master extraction + sample weighing, team-based), focusing on private label products and transit packaging (stretch wraps, bubble wraps).
steps.r: Sustainability/ESG Manager / EPR Compliance Manager

steps.a: Sustainability/ESG Manager / EPR Compliance Manager
steps.activity: Establish the BuildRight Plastic Packaging Taxonomy and map SKUs to their respective packaging profiles.
steps.r: Sustainability/ESG Manager / EPR Compliance Manager

steps.a: Sustainability/ESG Manager / EPR Compliance Manager
steps.activity: Calculate the baseline annual plastic footprint (in metric tons) using trailing 12-month sales and import volumes.
steps.r: Sustainability/ESG Manager / EPR Compliance Manager

fields.Participants: Master Data Analysts (VS-29), Product Developers (VS-41), Category Managers (VS-01)
fields.Trigger: Approved plastic baseline audit (W5153); new product creation process (VS-01.1)

workflows.name: ERP Item Master Plastic/Packaging Weight Fields Configuration

Automation Opportunity: - API verification enforcing non-zero entry in packaging weight fields before SKU release.
Controls: - CTL-767 (ensure controlled execution — Plastic Footprint Auditing, ERP Packaging Modeling & Registration (PA-179.1).)
- CTL-767: Master data validation rules prevent SKU creation without packaging weight verification.
Cross-references: - links to VS-29 (master data), VS-137 (PIM), VS-41 (private label), VS-01.1 (assortment)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Suppliers providing false packaging weights**: Over/under-calculation of footprint; mitigated by random sample weighing at DC quality control.
System Touchpoints: - ERP Item Master (VS-29), Product Information Management (PIM) system (VS-137).

steps.a: Master Data Manager
steps.activity: Configure new fields in the ERP Item Master for packaging material type, unit packaging weight (grams), and recycling tier.
steps.r: Master Data Manager

steps.a: Master Data Manager
steps.activity: Update the product onboarding workflow: require suppliers to fill in packaging weight fields before SKU generation approval.
steps.r: Master Data Manager

steps.a: Master Data Manager
steps.activity: Run data purification campaigns to fill in missing packaging fields for legacy SKUs.
steps.r: Master Data Manager

steps.a: Master Data Manager
steps.activity: Perform monthly system checks to ensure new SKUs have completed packaging metadata fields.
steps.r: Master Data Manager

fields.Owner: Vendor Compliance Lead / Quality Assurance Manager (VS-31)
fields.Trigger: New vendor onboarding (VS-03.1); annual vendor audit cycle (VS-25.2)

Automation Opportunity: - Supplier portal upload matching weight fields with OCR validation of certificates.
Controls: - CTL-767: Vendor compliance score integrated into vendor scorecard (VS-67); discrepancy alerts triggered.
Cross-references: - links to VS-03.1 (vendor onboarding), VS-25.2 (ESG sourcing), VS-31 (quality), VS-67 (vendor scorecard), VS-03.4 (vendor portal)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Supplier non-compliance**: Supplier refuses to disclose packaging details; mitigated by contractual vendor penalty clauses or vendor suspension warnings.
System Touchpoints: - Vendor portal (VS-03.4), DC receiving system (VS-04), Quality management system (VS-31).

steps.a: Vendor Compliance Lead / Quality Assurance Manager (VS-31)
steps.activity: Send packaging declaration forms and compliance guidelines to prospective and active suppliers.
steps.r: Vendor Compliance Lead / Quality Assurance Manager (VS-31)

steps.a: Vendor Compliance Lead / Quality Assurance Manager (VS-31)
steps.activity: Request official laboratory certification or material safety data sheets (MSDS) detailing packaging composition.
steps.r: Vendor Compliance Lead / Quality Assurance Manager (VS-31)

steps.a: Vendor Compliance Lead / Quality Assurance Manager (VS-31)
steps.activity: Perform sample measurements: weigh plastic components of vendor shipments during DC receiving audits.
steps.r: Vendor Compliance Lead / Quality Assurance Manager (VS-31)

steps.a: Vendor Compliance Lead / Quality Assurance Manager (VS-31)
steps.activity: Score vendor compliance: calculate discrepancy between declared packaging weight and actual audited weight.
steps.r: Vendor Compliance Lead / Quality Assurance Manager (VS-31)

fields.Owner: Private Label Brand Manager / Sustainability Lead
fields.Participants: Product Development Team (VS-41), Packaging Engineers (VS-111), Procurement, Suppliers
fields.Trigger: Product development review (VS-41); high plastic footprint optimization mandate

workflows.name: Private Label Packaging Material Substitution & Eco-Design Review

Automation Opportunity: - Simulation modeling for estimating carbon footprint reductions from material changes.
Controls: - CTL-767 (ensure controlled execution — Plastic Footprint Auditing, ERP Packaging Modeling & Registration (PA-179.1).)
- CTL-767: Eco-design sign-off by Quality and Sustainability/ESG Managers; updated specifications uploaded to document control (VS-88).
Cross-references: - links to VS-41 (private label), VS-111 (packaging), VS-137 (PIM), VS-88 (document control)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Material failure / Product damage**: Alternative packaging fails, increasing damage claims; mitigated by mandatory stress testing in DC packaging lab (VS-111).
System Touchpoints: - PIM system (VS-137), PL development portal (VS-41.1), Packaging specifications database (VS-111).

steps.a: Private Label Brand Manager / Sustainability Lead
steps.activity: Identify private label products with high plastic footprint (e.g. plastic handles, blister packs, bubble wrap).
steps.r: Private Label Brand Manager / Sustainability Lead

steps.a: Private Label Brand Manager / Sustainability Lead
steps.activity: Assess alternative materials: evaluate biodegradable plastics, recycled plastics, molded pulp, or cardboard alternatives.
steps.r: Private Label Brand Manager / Sustainability Lead

steps.a: Private Label Brand Manager / Sustainability Lead
steps.activity: Conduct engineering trials: test structural integrity, shelf-life, and moisture barrier properties of alternative packaging (VS-111).
steps.r: Private Label Brand Manager / Sustainability Lead

steps.a: Private Label Brand Manager / Sustainability Lead
steps.activity: Execute packaging transition plan: approve design, update supplier tooling, and update the ERP Item Master with new packaging weights.
steps.r: Private Label Brand Manager / Sustainability Lead

fields.Participants: IT Systems Engineer (VS-27), POS Admin (VS-08), Accounts Receivable (VS-16)
fields.Trigger: EOD transaction processing; monthly close data aggregation

workflows.name: Outbound Retail Plastic/Packaging Weight Calculation & Transaction Matching

Automation Opportunity: - Automated SQL ETL script running nightly to aggregate footprint metrics.
Controls: - CTL-767 (ensure controlled execution — Plastic Footprint Auditing, ERP Packaging Modeling & Registration (PA-179.1).)
- CTL-767: Footprint calculations reconciled to monthly sales volume reports; discrepancies investigated.
Cross-references: - links to VS-16 (O2C), VS-08 (POS), VS-27 (IT), VS-28 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Data lag / Sync failure**: POS transactions missing packaging metadata; mitigated by daily data error reports flagging SKUs with missing weights.
System Touchpoints: - ERP Sales module (VS-16), POS database (VS-08), ERP Reporting engine (VS-28).

steps.a: EPR Data Analyst
steps.activity: Execute daily database script: multiply POS SKU quantities sold by their Item Master packaging weight (W5154).
steps.r: EPR Data Analyst

steps.a: EPR Data Analyst
steps.activity: Aggregate packaging weight by plastic type (rigid, single-layer, multi-layer) and sales channel (POS walk-in, ecommerce delivery, B2B trade delivery).
steps.r: EPR Data Analyst

steps.a: EPR Data Analyst
steps.activity: Apply transaction rules: subtract returns/refund transactions to calculate net monthly plastic footprint distributed.
steps.r: EPR Data Analyst

steps.a: EPR Data Analyst
steps.activity: Generate monthly packaging volume reports for reconciliation against the recovery database.
steps.r: EPR Data Analyst

fields.Owner: EPR Compliance Manager / VP Legal & Compliance
fields.Participants: NSWMC Officer, Legal Operations (VS-100), CEO, Board
fields.Trigger: Initial EPR launch; structural changes in corporate legal footprint

workflows.name: National Solid Waste Management Commission (NSWMC) EPR Program Registration

Controls: - CTL-767: Program document signed by the CEO; verified compliance certificate maintained by Legal.
Cross-references: - links to VS-100 (legal), VS-88 (document control), VS-36 (governance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Registration rejection**: Incomplete recovery partner details causing rejection; mitigated by securing signed agreements with partners prior to filing.

steps.a: EPR Compliance Manager / VP Legal & Compliance
steps.activity: Prepare the BuildRight EPR Compliance Program document detailing plastic footprint calculation method, target recovery volumes (e.g. 20%), and planned recovery partnerships.
steps.r: EPR Compliance Manager / VP Legal & Compliance

steps.a: EPR Compliance Manager / VP Legal & Compliance
steps.activity: Submit registration documents to the NSWMC through the DENR online portal.
steps.r: EPR Compliance Manager / VP Legal & Compliance

steps.a: EPR Compliance Manager / VP Legal & Compliance
steps.activity: Address NSWMC queries, present details of the recovery network and PRO partnership agreement.
steps.r: EPR Compliance Manager / VP Legal & Compliance

steps.a: EPR Compliance Manager / VP Legal & Compliance
steps.activity: Secure official EPR Registration Certificate and register number from the NSWMC.
steps.r: EPR Compliance Manager / VP Legal & Compliance

fields.Participants: PRO Representatives, Legal Operations (VS-100), Finance (VS-17.4), Procurement (VS-03)
fields.Trigger: Approved EPR strategy; annual compliance program review

workflows.name: Producer Responsibility Organization (PRO) Enrollment & SLA Management

Automation Opportunity: - Data upload to PRO portal via API.
Controls: - CTL-767 (ensure controlled execution — Plastic Footprint Auditing, ERP Packaging Modeling & Registration (PA-179.1).)
- CTL-767: PRO contracts approved by VP Legal and COO; payments authorized only upon receipt of accredited recovery audit documents.
Cross-references: - links to VS-100 (legal), VS-17.4 (FP&A), VS-15 (P2P), VS-67 (vendor scorecard)
Pain Points / Risks: - **PRO failure to recover target volume**: BuildRight face fines due to PRO default; mitigated by contractual indemnity clauses and secondary recovery partner agreements.
System Touchpoints: - PRO portal, ERP accounts payable (VS-15), Vendor scorecard (VS-67).

steps.a: EPR Compliance Manager / Sustainability/ESG Manager
steps.activity: Conduct due diligence on accredited Producer Responsibility Organizations (PROs) in the Philippines.
steps.r: EPR Compliance Manager / Sustainability/ESG Manager

steps.a: EPR Compliance Manager / Sustainability/ESG Manager
steps.activity: Negotiate PRO Service Level Agreement (SLA): define fee structures, target recovery volumes assigned, reporting timelines, and recovery certification audit rules.
steps.r: EPR Compliance Manager / Sustainability/ESG Manager

steps.a: EPR Compliance Manager / Sustainability/ESG Manager
steps.activity: Submit monthly plastic footprint reports (W5157) to the PRO; coordinate payment of PRO admin and recovery fees.
steps.r: EPR Compliance Manager / Sustainability/ESG Manager

steps.a: EPR Compliance Manager / Sustainability/ESG Manager
steps.activity: Conduct quarterly reviews of PRO performance: track actual recovered volume against contractual targets.
steps.r: EPR Compliance Manager / Sustainability/ESG Manager

fields.Owner: Real Estate & Operations Controller / EPR Compliance Manager
fields.Participants: Finance FP&A (VS-17.4), Category Managers (VS-01), VP Merchandising
fields.Trigger: Annual corporate budget cycle (VS-33); monthly close calculations

workflows.name: EPR Budgeting, Cost Allocation & Plastic Fee Management

Automation Opportunity: - ERP automated monthly cost allocation posting based on SKU sales weights.
Controls: - CTL-767 (ensure controlled execution — Plastic Footprint Auditing, ERP Packaging Modeling & Registration (PA-179.1).)
- CTL-767: Allocation approved by Controller; monthly variance reporting shared with VP Merchandising.
Cross-references: - links to VS-33 (strategy), VS-17.4 (FP&A), VS-158 (product costing)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Budget deficit**: Spiking plastic recovery costs causing budget blowout; mitigated by hedging recovery prices through long-term partner contracts.
System Touchpoints: - ERP Budgeting module (VS-33.1), Cost accounting system (VS-158), GL (VS-17.1).

steps.a: Real Estate & Operations Controller / EPR Compliance Manager
steps.activity: Estimate annual EPR compliance cost: compute PRO fees, partner recovery fees, logistics costs, and audit fees based on footprint forecast.
steps.r: Real Estate & Operations Controller / EPR Compliance Manager

steps.a: Real Estate & Operations Controller / EPR Compliance Manager
steps.activity: Create cost allocation model: allocate EPR expenses to departments/categories based on their plastic packaging footprint share.
steps.r: Real Estate & Operations Controller / EPR Compliance Manager

steps.a: Real Estate & Operations Controller / EPR Compliance Manager
steps.activity: Integrate plastic fees into private label product costing sheets as an overhead landed cost component (VS-158).
steps.r: Real Estate & Operations Controller / EPR Compliance Manager

steps.a: Real Estate & Operations Controller / EPR Compliance Manager
steps.activity: Review monthly actual EPR spending against budget; adjust category cost-allocations.
steps.r: Real Estate & Operations Controller / EPR Compliance Manager
